Name: A Harrass of Horses - A Green's Horses Cont' Add-on
Author: BasfulVixen
Description:
[size=2]I just wanted more horsiessss................[/size]

[size=3]A variety of additional horse types to enjoy on the the Green's Horses model

:: FEATURES ::
19 Different horse Sprites
20 Tack color options
7 Metal armor options[/size]

[font=Times New Roman]~*~Breeds~*~[/font]
 All based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/GreenJellyblob]GreenJellyblob's [/url]horse model with the coding from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Doragoun]Doragoun[/url]

[list]
[*]Appaloosa (Black, Red)
[*]Clydesdale
[*]Dullahan
[*]Fjord
[*]Unicorns (Both High and Low fantasy)
[*]Jackstock Donkey
[*]Kelpie
[*]Paint (Black, Red)
[*]Palomino
[*]Pega Donkey (Brown, Gray, White)
[*]Quagga
[*]Romani Vanner (English Cob)
[*]Sleipnir (the 8 legged horse)
[*]Zebra
[/list]
~*~Tack & Armor~*~

Metal Armors 
[list]
[*]Copper
[*]Iron
[*]Black Iron
[*]Steel
[*]Silver
[*]Gold
[*]Iridium
[/list]Streamers of every color
Bridles of every color
A special Lillypad Tack for the Kelpie

~*~﻿Possible updates[font=Times New Roman][size=3]~*~[/size][/font]

More horse armor (Padded)
More varieties of ribbon tack
More Horse Breeds
[font=Times New Roman][size=3]
~*~INSTALLATION~*~[/size][/font]

1. Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29630]Green's Horses Continued[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] so download those first
﻿Recommended to download Generic Mod Config Menu for easy horse choosing
2. Extract ZIP Folders﻿ into Stardew Valley mods folder
3. Have fun with your new steed~

Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to switch between horses - Use NONE if you want to ride a ghost.
Otherwise switch horses in the config file.

REQUIRES Content Patcher to work
